fixture.description: Status of the Warm Standby of `spawn.standby` after it WON the Takeover of its workload (spec §6.5, §7.1 steps 3–4). The primary provider went silent on its Relay Set; this provider announced `directory.takeover` at `now`, waited the settle window of two cadences, found its own claim the earliest from any member of the `standby_set`, and started the workload from the image exactly as a spawn would, with no state carried over (ADR 0010). `state` is now `running` and `access` is where the workload runs; `role` is still `standby`, because a role is a position in the set and never changes; and `takeover.winner` names this provider. `expires_at` is the reservation's own: winning buys no time, so a full-price `.extend` is due before it or the sweep ends the lease. `.standby.extend` is refused `not_standby` from here on.
